query_analysis.original_query: Calculate the theoretical minimum energy required to separate a binary gas-liquid mixture under isothermal conditions. The feed stream contains 60 mol% Component A and 40 mol% Component B, entering at a pressure of 5 bar and a temperature of 298 K. The desired products are a gas stream with 95 mol% Component A and a liquid stream with 90 mol% Component B. Assume ideal gas and liquid behavior, and neglect heat losses or inefficiencies in the separation process.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Calculate the theoretical energy efficiency of a binary gas-liquid separation process under isothermal conditions, considering the specified feed composition and desired product purity.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Thermodynamic data and process parameters sharing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative process design and energy efficiency optimization

clarification_questions: Are there any specific constraints or additional requirements for the separation process?
